mkdir lib && cd lib && grep -v '^#' ../lib-7.md5 | awk '{print $2}' | wget -i- -c -B https://www.x.org/pub/individual/lib/ && md5sum -c ../lib-7.md5
user:
cd lib && for package in $(grep -v '^#' ../lib-7.md5 | awk '{print $2}'); do
  packagedir=${package%.tar.?z*}
  echo "Building $packagedir"
  tar -xf $package
  pushd $packagedir
  case $packagedir in
    libXfont2-[0-9]* )
      ./configure $XORG_CONFIG --disable-devel-docs
      make
    ;;
    libXt-[0-9]* )
      ./configure $XORG_CONFIG --with-appdefaultdir=/etc/X11/app-defaults
      make
    ;;
    libXpm-[0-9]* )
      ./configure $XORG_CONFIG --disable-open-zfile
      make
    ;;
    libpciaccess* | libxkbfile* )
      meson setup build --prefix=$XORG_PREFIX --buildtype=release
      ninja -C build
    ;;
    * )
      ./configure $XORG_CONFIG
      make
    ;;
  esac
  popd
done
package:
cd lib && for package in $(grep -v '^#' ../lib-7.md5 | awk '{print $2}'); do
  packagedir=${package%.tar.?z*}
  pushd $packagedir
  case $packagedir in
    libpciaccess* | libxkbfile* )
      DESTDIR=$DESTDIR ninja -C build install
    ;;
    * )
      make install DESTDIR=$DESTDIR
    ;;
  esac
  popd
  rm -rf $packagedir
done
